title: Create : Netherite Craft
description: Craft Netherite with diamonds and an Industrial Furnace !
body: ## __**Finally add a true Netherite crafting path with Create !**__ With this addon, the Create: Industrial Furnace mod becomes even more powerful. Combine Create’s mechanics with the efficiency of the Industrial Furnace to unlock a new recipe fully integrated into the gameplay. With this addon, you can now **smelt a diamond in the Industrial Furnace** to obtain an **Ancient Debris**. This new use of the furnace enhances progression, offering an immersive and coherent way to access Netherite through Create. Perfect for tech packs, progression-based challenges, or worlds focused on advanced automation !   ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1398591/description_6f1564ec-9003-4954-9e3b-f7c188a194cc.png)
